verses.text: A song for going up to worship. LORD, remember David and all the hardships he went through.
Remember how he made a promise to the LORD, a vow to the Mighty One of Jacob:
"I will not go into my house or go to bed.
I will not let my eyes sleep or my eyelids close
until I find a place for the LORD, a home for the Mighty One of Jacob."
We heard about the ark in Ephrathah. We found it in the fields of Jaar.
"Let's go to the place where he lives. Let's worship at his footstool."
Get up, LORD, and come to your resting place, you and the ark that shows your strength.
May your priests be dressed in goodness. May your faithful people shout for joy!
For the sake of your servant David, do not reject your anointed king.
The LORD made a sure promise to David that he will not take back: "I will put one of your own descendants on your throne.
If your children keep my covenant and the laws I teach them, then their children will also sit on your throne forever."
The LORD has chosen Zion. He wanted it as his home.
He said, "This is my resting place forever. I will live here, because this is what I wanted.
I will bless it with plenty of food. I will satisfy its poor people with bread.
I will dress its priests in salvation. Its faithful people will shout for joy.
Here I will make David's power grow. I have prepared a lamp for my anointed king.
I will dress his enemies in shame, but his crown will shine."
